subject: general
question: The withdrawal of United Kingdom from the European Union is referred to more commonly as:
solution:
The correct answer is **__Brexit__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brexit**

 
 
• Brexit, an acronym for the words **"Britain" and "exit," refers to the United Kingdom's (UK) withdrawal from the European Union (EU)** on **January 31, 2020**. 
 
• The only **sovereign nation** to have left the EU is the UK.
 
• Since** January 1, 1973**, the UK has belonged to both the **European Union (EU) and the European Communities (EC)**.
 
• After Brexit, **British laws no longer take priority over EU law** or the rulings of the European Court of Justice, with the exception of a few circumstances involving Northern Ireland. 
 
• The **relevant EU law is still domestic law** under the **European Union (Withdrawal) Act 2018**, which the UK may now modify or repeal. 
 
• In accordance with the terms of the Brexit withdrawal agreement, **Northern Ireland is still a de facto member of the EU Customs Union** and continues to trade in the **European Single Market**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Any Member State's withdrawal procedure is governed by **Article 50 of the Treaty of the European Union**.
 
• This principle states that any **EU member may decide to leave the union** in accordance with its national constitution.
 
• The EU will **negotiate** with this State about the timing and terms of its withdrawal from the EU after notifying it of its decision.
 
• Following the **23 June, 2016 referendum and the subsequent 29 March 2017 notification** to the European Council, the United Kingdom's withdrawal process got underway.
 
• The cooperation agreement, which was officially ratified on** 1 May 2021 and went into effect on 1 January 2021**, will play a role in determining some of the effects of Brexit.
